editorial:
Imagine trying to start over after a terrible car crash, only to find out the person you hurt has moved in right next door. That is exactly what happens to Amber and Kyle. They think they have finally moved past the guilt of the accident from two years ago, but then Jessica shows up. She is the woman who lost her baby in that crash, and she is not there to make peace. She has a scary, calculated plan to get back at them by infiltrating their lives and working for Amber's doctor. It feels like a classic Lifetime thriller where you just know something bad is about to happen, but you can't stop watching to see how far she will go.

The acting is solid and does a great job of making you feel uneasy as Jessica slowly takes over. While the plot follows some predictable beats, the tension keeps things moving along quickly. If you love stories about revenge and secrets, you will really enjoy this one. It is a great pick for a lazy weekend movie night. You can easily rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch or add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you want the best picture quality possible. It is a simple, gripping story that delivers exactly what you expect from a revenge thriller.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Jessica's plan to destroy Amber's life comes to a head. After a tense battle, it is revealed that Jessica's obsession led her to commit several crimes to get her revenge. Amber manages to fight back and survive the encounter. Jessica is eventually caught and stopped, ensuring she can no longer hurt the couple. The movie ends with Amber and Kyle finally finding some peace and safety now that the threat is gone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge stories and suspenseful TV movies.
